summary: The Boston Beer Company filed an 8-K announcing a 10b5-1 plan to repurchase up to $25 million of its Class A Common Stock during a period from June 29, 2026 to September 25, 2026. The repurchase is an issuer share buyback undertaken under a pre-arranged trading plan to allow repurchases during blackout periods. The filing includes no details on board recommendation or advisors. The mechanics are a standard 10b5-1 plan, reducing shares outstanding and returning capital to shareholders. Watch for the actual pace of repurchases and any impact on EPS.
